title: What a Companion Knows About the Hall of Creation
purpose: PROCEDURAL knowledge of VihuStudio as it is actually built — where a control is, what pressing it does, and what to say to a child who cannot find it. It is not world canon: what VihuPlanet IS lives in vihuplanet.canon.json, and nothing here restates it. Every entry was read off the running product; nothing was inferred from how software usually works.
howToUse: A Companion may say where a control is and what it does. It never presses one, never claims to have done anything, and never names a control that is not on the screen the child is looking at.

surfaces.name: Studio Home
surfaces.childName: the screen you land on when you come to make something
whatIsHere: Your journey begins / Now Look What You Can Make — the screen that offers ways to start.
Three named starting points once a first story is finished: My Little Story, Character Card, Little Message.
If a story was left unfinished: 'You were making something', its name, and Carry on.
A door to the next story, when there is one waiting.
surfaces.evidence: js/creationFlow.js — 'Begin', 'Carry on', 'Discover', 'My Little Story', 'Character Card', 'Little Message'

surfaces.name: the Story Editor
whatIsHere: The page itself, in the middle.
PAGES down the left, with + Add Page under them.
The panel on the right, where things are added and changed.
Play My Story and Finish Story at the top, which wake up once there is something on the page.
The story's name at the top, which can be tapped and changed.

surfaces.name: the Ether
whatIsHere: Stories other people have shared, drifting.
Nothing is made here — this is where finished stories live.

capabilities.name: Starting a story
capabilities.entryPoint: One of the named starting points on Studio Home — My Little Story, Character Card or Little Message.
steps: Pick the one that sounds like what you want to make.
The story opens, with one page ready.
capabilities.expectedResult: The Story Editor opens with an empty first page.
commonProblems: Nothing to pick from — a first story has not been finished yet, and there is a Begin instead.

capabilities.name: Putting something on the page
capabilities.entryPoint: The panel on the right of the page.
steps: Look at the panel on the right.
Tap the one you want. It goes on the page and you can move it.
capabilities.expectedResult: The thing appears on the page and can be dragged.
commonProblems: A tile is not there — not everything is there from the start. What a child has met so far is what shows.
On Studio Home there is no panel at all: a story has to be open first.
capabilities.evidence: js/contextPanel.js lines 3678-3705 — the real tile list, with its real labels

capabilities.name: Adding a page
capabilities.entryPoint: + Add Page, under the list of pages on the left.
steps: Tap + Add Page at the bottom of that list.
capabilities.expectedResult: A new empty page appears at the end and opens.

capabilities.name: Naming a story
capabilities.entryPoint: The story's name across the top.
steps: Tap the name at the top.
capabilities.expectedResult: The story is called that everywhere — in your stories, and on the page if the World shows it.

capabilities.name: Playing a story back
capabilities.entryPoint: Play My Story, at the top.
capabilities.expectedResult: The story plays through, page by page.
commonProblems: It looks asleep — there is nothing on the page yet, or a story chapter is running and has not finished.
capabilities.evidence: studio.html — #playStoryBtn, label 'Play My Story', class is-asleep when disabled

capabilities.name: Finishing a story
steps: Two choices come up: take the story, or share it with VihuPlanet.
Neither one is the one you have to pick.
capabilities.expectedResult: Every part of the story is made and handed over. Sharing is a separate choice.
commonProblems: It looks asleep — same as Play My Story.

capabilities.name: Going back
capabilities.entryPoint: 🏠 at the top left goes to Studio Home. 🌌 goes back out to the Ether.
steps: Tap 🏠 for Studio Home, or 🌌 to go out to VihuPlanet.
capabilities.expectedResult: The story is kept on its own — nothing has to be saved by hand.

capabilities.name: My Garden
capabilities.entryPoint: 🪴 My Garden in the panel on the right.
steps: It opens on two rooms — your drawings, and your letters.
Tap one to put it on the page, or tap an empty letter to make it.
capabilities.expectedResult: Your own drawing or your own letter goes on the page.
commonProblems: The tile is not there — My Garden is one of the things a child meets as they go.
capabilities.evidence: js/contextPanel.js — data-add-id 'library', label 'My Garden' · CLAUDE.md Decision 27

capabilities.name: Talking to your Companion
capabilities.entryPoint: The small opener at the foot of the screen, or tapping the Companion.
steps: Type, or use 🎤 to say it out loud.
capabilities.expectedResult: The conversation opens at the bottom. Closing it forgets what was said.

capabilities.name: Keeping a story safe
steps: Nothing to do. It saves on its own while you work.
capabilities.expectedResult: The story is there when you come back, on Studio Home under 'You were making something'.

neverSay: Any control not listed above — a Companion that invents a button sends a child looking for something that is not there.
That it pressed anything, added anything, changed anything or saved anything itself.
